rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: When separate requests for CT abdomen and CT Pelvis are encountered for processes involving both the abdomen and pelvis, they need to be resubmitted as Evolent Clinical Guideline 2000 for Abdomen and Pelvis CT (to avoid unbundling; CPT codes 74176, 74177, 74178).

criteria.description: Separate requests submitted for CT Abdomen and CT Pelvis
Clinical process or pathology involves both abdominal and pelvic anatomy

required_documentation: Clinical indication demonstrating pathology is strictly confined to upper abdomen if isolated CT Abdomen requested
rules.review_notes: Anti-unbundling coding rule mandating combined CT Abdomen/Pelvis codes (74176-74178) when both regions are indicated.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: After confirmed diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI), one-time imaging to exclude a secondary cause for EPI. (Imaging is not indicated for workup of suspected pancreatic insufficiency; fecal elastase level < 100 µg/g is consistent with EPI)

criteria.description: Diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency confirmed by fecal elastase
One-time imaging evaluation to exclude secondary structural etiology

required_documentation: Fecal elastase laboratory report demonstrating < 100 ug/g
exclusion_conditions: Imaging requested for initial workup of suspected pancreatic insufficiency prior to fecal elastase confirmation
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite mandating fecal elastase confirmation before one-time diagnostic CT.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Indeterminate renal mass on other imaging (13) ● Active surveillance for a solid renal mass(es) at 6 and 12 months, then annually

criteria.description: Known solid renal mass undergoing active surveillance
Surveillance interval matches protocol (6 mo, 12 mo, then annually)

required_documentation: Prior ultrasound, CT, or MRI report documenting solid renal mass and date of last scan
rules.review_notes: Surveillance interval rule for solid renal mass active surveillance.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: Evaluation of Infection and Inflammation / Pancreatitis: Suspected and Known (27)
rules.source_quote: In patients > 40 years of age who have pancreatitis with no identifiable cause (to exclude neoplasm)

criteria.description: Patient age strictly greater than 40 years
No identifiable cause established (idiopathic, no gallstones/alcohol etiology)

required_documentation: Clinical notes demonstrating idiopathic pancreatitis in patient over 40 and negative basic etiology workup
rules.review_notes: Age-stratified oncology exclusion rule for idiopathic pancreatitis in patients over 40.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: Infection and Inflammation Limited to the Abdomen (27,29) / Hernia (30)
rules.source_quote: Suspected hernia and one of the following: ○ Deep intraabdominal/pelvic hernia (post-Roux-en-Y) ○ Non-midline ventral hernia (including Spigelian hernia)

criteria.description: Deep intraabdominal hernia post-gastric bypass OR non-midline ventral/Spigelian hernia
Post-Roux-en-Y gastric bypass with suspected internal hernia
Suspected non-midline ventral hernia or Spigelian hernia

required_documentation: Surgical or clinical notes detailing bariatric surgical history or physical examination of non-midline abdominal defect
rules.review_notes: Complex abdominal wall and internal hernia indication.
